schema1.title: Inventory Manager Discovery Schema
schema1.description: The shape of the discovery object generated within Inventory Manager for a successfully parsed metadata document. This is the internal metadata format used within the system and ultimately sent downstream to OneStop.

dsmmAverage.description: Calculated mean average of individual DSMM scores for Accessibility, Data Integrity, Data Quality Assessment, Data Quality Assurance, Data Quality Control Monitoring, Preservability, Production Sustainability, Transparency Traceability, and Usability.

services.description: List of objects that represent an SV_ServiceIdentification section, if any, of ISO 19115 XML metadata document. Empty if not present.

Geometry.description: One geometry as defined by GeoJSON

lineString.description: An array of two or more positions

linearRing.description: An array of four positions where the first equals the last
